skills.name: Foxball Summon
skills.description: Brown uses the power of the Foxball. Good effects on allies.  *Removes allies' debuffs  *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (8 sec) *Reflects 80% of incoming skill damage as magic damage (8 sec)

skills.name: Shikigami Summon
skills.description: Brown summons a Shikigami that attacks enemies at the front. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy buffs   *Enemy Skill Hit Rate -40% (7 sec) *ATK x 3300% Area Damage

abilities.name: Gas Mask
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't take damage in advent stages  with the Poison Gas obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Agility
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Agility type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
